DemonHunterMasteryPuncturingArrow.name: Puncturing Arrow
DemonHunterMasteryPuncturingArrow.description: Increase the number of Hungering Arrow bounces by 1. Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Hungering Arrow refunds 40 Mana and permanently increases the damage of its initial impact by 6.

DemonHunterMultishotFireAtWill.name: Fire At Will
DemonHunterMultishotFireAtWill.description: Quest: Hitting a Hero with Multishot grants 2 Hatred and permanently increases its damage by 2. Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes with Multishot, increase its damage by 40.

DemonHunterCreedoftheHunter.name: Creed of the Hunter
DemonHunterCreedoftheHunter.description: Quest: Every 50 Basic Attacks against Heroes increases Hatred's damage bonus per stack by 1%, up to 6%. Gambit: Gain 25% bonus Attack Speed. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

DemonHunterMasteryArsenal.name: Arsenal
DemonHunterMasteryArsenal.description: Increase the range of Multishot by 20%. Multishot also fires 3 grenades that deal 100 (+4% per level) damage and refund 25 Mana after hitting enemy Heroes.

DemonHunterDeathDealer.name: Death Dealer
DemonHunterDeathDealer.description: Increase Vaults Basic Attack damage bonus from 6% to 15% per stack of Hatred. If this attack kills its victim within 1.5 seconds, the Mana cost and cooldown of Vault are refunded. Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Vault by 5 seconds.

DemonHunterMasteryRepeatingArrowVault.name: Repeating Arrow
DemonHunterMasteryRepeatingArrowVault.description: Vault no longer has a Mana cost. Casting Vault resets the cooldown of Hungering Arrow.

DemonHunterMasteryMonsterHunterHungering.name: Monster Hunter
DemonHunterMasteryMonsterHunterHungering.description: Hungering Arrow deals 150% additional damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

DemonHunterMasteryFrostShot.name: Frost Shot
DemonHunterMasteryFrostShot.description: Multishot Slows enemies by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Hungering Arrows deals 25% more damage to Slowed enemies.

DemonHunterCombatStyleHotPursuit.name: Hot Pursuit
DemonHunterCombatStyleHotPursuit.description: Increase the Movement Speed bonus of each stack of Hatred to 2%.

DemonHunterHeroicAbilityStrafe.name: Strafe
DemonHunterHeroicAbilityStrafe.description: Rapidly attack enemies within 10 range for 60 (+4% per level) damage per hit, prioritizing Heroes over Minions. Valla is able to move and use Vault while strafing. Lasts for 4 seconds.

DemonHunterHeroicAbilityRainofVengeance.name: Rain of Vengeance
DemonHunterHeroicAbilityRainofVengeance.description: Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds. Stores up to 2 charges.

DemonHunterMasterySiphoningArrow.name: Siphoning Arrows
DemonHunterMasterySiphoningArrow.description: Hitting a Hero with Hungering Arrow heals Valla for 4% of her maximum Health, and Multishot heals for 2%.

DemonHunterCombatStyleTemperedByDiscipli.name: Tempered by Discipline
DemonHunterCombatStyleTemperedByDiscipli.description: Basic Attacks heal for 10% of the damage dealt, increased by 2% per Hatred stack.

DemonHunterGloom.name: Gloom
DemonHunterGloom.description: Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds. Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2 (+4% per level) Health per second.

DemonHunterPunishment.name: Punishment
DemonHunterPunishment.description: While at max Hatred, Multishot's cooldown recharges 50% faster.

DemonHunterSeethingHatred.name: Seething Hatred
DemonHunterSeethingHatred.description: While at max Hatred, increase all damage dealt by 10%.

DemonHunterManticore.name: Manticore
DemonHunterManticore.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 5% of their maximum Health as damage.

DemonHunterMasteryDeathSiphon.name: Death Siphon
DemonHunterMasteryDeathSiphon.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Strafe increases its duration by 0.125 seconds. Strafe also fires penetrating bolts in a line for 34 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds.

DemonHunterMasteryStormofVengeance.name: Storm of Vengeance
DemonHunterMasteryStormofVengeance.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Rain of Vengeance by 5 seconds. Passive: Each stack of Hatred increases your Attack Speed by 2%. While at max Hatred, gain an additional 30% Attack Speed.

DemonHunterVaultAcrobat.name: Acrobat
DemonHunterVaultAcrobat.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Vault. Drop 3 Caltrops while Vaulting that deal 60 (+4% per level) damage and Slow enemies by 40% for 1 second.

DemonHunterFarflightQuiver.name: Farflight Quiver
DemonHunterFarflightQuiver.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack range. While at max Hatred, gain an additional 30% Basic Attack range.
